title: haplopappus palmeri subsp. typicus
intro: Haplopappus palmeri subsp. typicus, commonly known as Palmer's Chrysopsis, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, primarily to treat various health issues. The plant has been found to exhibit health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in soothing digestive issues and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Haplopappus palmeri subsp. typicus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
